LBR.note: Nothing on a civil register and ID link.
No enrolment count or share for the national ID.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the system.
No register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The National Identification Registry is to provide technical infrastructure and biometric identification expertise so that each eligible migrant registered between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-31 receives a unique identity and is enrolled in Liberia's National Biometric Identification System (LRRRC, via FrontPageAfrica).

LBR.note: No duplicate checks or certification stated.
Nothing on local government offices or their connection.
The exercise registers undocumented migrants, chiefly Burkinabe nationals, and the document does not call them refugees or displaced people.
